```javascript
import { Pattern, Step, Rest } from 'strudel';

const kick = new Pattern([
  new Step(1), // Kick on beat 1
  new Rest(1), // Rest on beat 2
  new Rest(1), // Rest on beat 3
  new Step(1)  // Kick on beat 4
]);

const hiHat = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 1), // Hi-hat on every 16th note
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1)
]);

const bassline = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 2), // Bass on beat 1, holds for 2 steps
  new Rest(2),    // Rest for 2 steps
  new Step(1, 2), // Bass on beat 1, holds for 2 steps
  new Rest(2)     // Rest for 2 steps
]);

const lead = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1), // Lead on beat 1, 0.25 duration, volume 1
  new Rest(3),          // Rest for 3 steps
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1), // Lead on beat 1, 0.25 duration, volume 1
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3)
]);

kick.play();
hiHat.play({
  volume: 0.5, // Lower volume for hi-hats
  pan: 0.5     // Pan to center
});
bassline.play({
  volume: 0.8, // Slightly louder bassline
  pan: -0.5    // Pan to left
});
lead.play({
  volume: 0.5, // Slightly quieter lead
  pan: 0.5     // Pan to center
});
```

```javascript
import { Sequence, Pattern, Live } from 'strudel'
import { kick, snare, hatOpen, hatClosed, lead, bass } from 'strudel-instruments'

const loopLength = 16

const drums = new Pattern([
  [0, kick, 0.5],
  [2, hatOpen, 0.5],
  [4, kick, 0.5],
  [5, hatClosed, 0.5],
  [7, snare, 0.5],
  [9, hatOpen, 0.5],
  [11, kick, 0.5],
  [12, hatClosed, 0.5],
  [14, snare, 0.5]
])

const bassline = new Pattern([
  [0, 0, 0.5],
  [4, 1, 0.5],
  [8, 0, 0.5],
  [12, 1, 0.5]
])

const leadPattern = new Pattern([
  [0, lead({ freq: 140 }), 0.25],
  [4, lead({ freq: 120 }), 0.25],
  [8, lead({ freq: 100 }), 0.25],
  [12, lead({ freq: 80 }), 0.25]
])

const loop = new Sequence([drums, bassline, leadPattern])

Live.play(loop, loopLength)
```

import { Sequence, Pattern, Step } from 'strudel'

const kick = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1)
])

const hiHats = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Step(0, 1)
])

const bassline = new Pattern([
  new Step(120, 1),
  new Step(117, 1),
  new Step(114, 1),
  new Step(111, 1),
  new Step(108, 1),
  new Step(105, 1),
  new Step(102, 1),
  new Step(99, 1)
])

const lead = new Pattern([
  new Step(60, 1),
  new Step(64, 1),
  new Step(67, 1),
  new Step(72, 1),
  new Step(76, 1),
  new Step(80, 1),
  new Step(84, 1),
  new Step(88, 1)
])

const loop = new Sequence([
  kick,
  hiHats,
  bassline,
  lead
])

loop.play()

import { str, seq, loop, pad, note, amp, pan } from 'strudel'

const kick = pad('kick', 1)
const hiHats = pad('ride', 2, { amp: 0.5, pan: 0.5 })
const bassline = seq([
  note('C3', 1, 0.5, { amp: 0.7 }),
  note('E3', 1, 0.5, { amp: 0.7 }),
  note('G3', 1, 0.5, { amp: 0.7 }),
  note('Bb3', 1, 0.5, { amp: 0.7 })
], 4)

const lead = seq([
  note('C4', 1, 1, { amp: 0.5 }),
  note('E4', 1, 1, { amp: 0.5 }),
  note('G4', 1, 1, { amp: 0.5 }),
  note('B4', 1, 1, { amp: 0.5 })
], 4)

const loop = loop([kick, hiHats, bassline, lead], 4)

str(loop)

const kick = Pattern.cycle([
  0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0
])

const hiHats = Pattern.cycle([
  1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1
])

const bassline = Pattern.cycle([
  0, 0, 0, 120, 0, 0, 0, 123
])

const melodicPart = Pattern.cycle([
  0, 0, 0, 72, 0, 0, 0, 74
])

const loop = Pattern.cycle([
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick: 0, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats },
  { kick, hiHats }
])

Pattern.merge([
  loop,
  bassline,
  melodicPart
])

const kick = t => t % 4 === 0 ? 1 : 0
const hiHat = t => t % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0
const bass = t => Math.sin(t / 4) * 0.5 + 0.5
const stab = t => (t % 16 === 0 || t % 16 === 8) ? 1 : 0

Loop({
  samples: 64,
  parts: [
    { name: 'Kick', enabled: kick },
    { name: 'HiHat', enabled: hiHat },
    { name: 'Bass', enabled: bass },
    { name: 'Stab', enabled: stab }
  ]
})

```javascript
import { Pattern, Note, Rhythm, Strudel } from 'strudel'

const kick = Pattern({
  1: [Note('C1'), Note('C1', -1)],
  2: [Note('A1'), Note('A1', -1)],
  4: [Note('F1'), Note('F1', -1)],
  8: [Note('G1'), Note('G1', -1)]
})

const hiHats = Pattern({
  1: [Note('C1'), Note('C1', -1)],
  2: [Note('A1'), Note('A1', -1)],
  4: [Note('F1'), Note('F1', -1)],
  8: [Note('G1'), Note('G1', -1)]
})

const bassline = Pattern({
  1: [Note('C1', 1), Note('C1', -1)],
  2: [Note('A1', 1), Note('A1', -1)],
  4: [Note('F1', 1), Note('F1', -1)],
  8: [Note('G1', 1), Note('G1', -1)]
})

const lead = Pattern({
  1: [Note('C2', 1), Note('C2', -1)],
  2: [Note('A2', 1), Note('A2', -1)],
  4: [Note('F2', 1), Note('F2', -1)],
  8: [Note('G2', 1), Note('G2', -1)]
})

Strudel.sequence([
  Pattern.merge(kick, hiHats),
  bassline,
  lead
])
```

  = stack( \
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").crush(4).decay(0.08).lpq(15).pan(0.5), \
    s("sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").crush(4).decay(0.08).lpq(15).pan(0.5) \
  )

[bass] bassline_tunnel \
  = note("[~ e1 ~ ~] [~ e1 ~ e1] [~ e1 ~ ~] [~ f1 ~ e1]").s("saw").decay(0.12).lpq(10).lpf(2000).decay(0.06).crush(4).room(0.5).size(2)

[melody] melody_tunnel \
  = note("[c3 eb3 b2 c3] [g3 c4 fis3 c3]").s("triangle").decay(0.08).lpf(sine.range(500, 1800)).delay(0.5).crush(4).decay(0.1)

[all] \
  = stack( \
    drums_techno_tunnel, \
    bassline_tunnel, \
    melody_tunnel, \
  ).iter(4).cp(100)

import { Loop } from 'strudel'

const kick = (t) => t % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0
const snare = (t) => t % 4 === 2 ? 1 : 0
const hat = (t) => (t % 16 < 8 ? 1 : 0) * (t % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0)

const bass = (t) => Math.sin(t / 10) * 0.3 + 0.7
const lead = (t) => Math.sin(t / 20) * 0.3 + 0.5

const loop = new Loop(16, () => [kick, snare, hat, bass, lead])
loop.play()

import { tempo } from 'strudel'

tempo(128)

const kick = (t) => (t % 4 == 0) ? 0.8 : 0
const hiHats = (t) => (t % 2 == 0) ? 0.5 : 0
const bassline = (t) => Math.sin(t / 16) * 0.3 + 0.3
const stab = (t) => (t % 8 == 0) ? 0.7 : 0

sequence([
  [kick, hiHats, bassline, stab]
], { repeats: 8 })

```javascript
strudel.define("bass", (t) => 0.3 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 20 * t))
strudel.define("drums", (t) => strudel.sequence([
  {at: 0, value: 1},
  {at: 0.25, value: 1},
  {at: 0.75, value: 1},
  {at: 1, value: 0}
]))
strudel.define("melodic", (t) => 0.1 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 15 * t))
strudel.define("loop", (t) => strudel.sequence([
  {at: 0, value: strudel.mix([strudel.bass(t), strudel.drums(t), strudel.melodic(t)])},
  {at: 0.5, value: strudel.mix([strudel.bass(t + 0.5), strudel.drums(t + 0.5), strudel.melodic(t + 0.5)])}
]))
strudel.loop(strudel.loop, 4)
```
